annotations.title: Okapi BM25 + Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) + MMR Chunk Reranker

description: Reranks and deduplicates candidate RAG or retrieval passages against a search prompt using Okapi BM25 (k1=1.5, b=0.75), Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), and Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) Jaccard diversity filtering. Use when selecting the top-K highest-signal, non-redundant passages from vector search or grep results; for compressing a single contiguous source file while keeping its original line order, use prune_context_skeleton instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'search_prompt' ('documents_json' defaults to 'standard'), uses '?demo=true' or L402 (50 sats); HTTP 400 if invalid.

documents_json.description: JSON string or array of candidate chunks '[{"id":"c1","text":"..."}]' to rerank.

ranking_mode.description: Fusion weighting between lexical BM25 and diversity penalty; defaults to 'bm25_rrf_mmr' when omitted.

search_prompt.description: Technical search prompt or question used to score candidate chunks.

top_k.description: Maximum number of deduplicated chunks to return; defaults to 5 when omitted.

name: rerank_hybrid_rag_chunks

ranked_chunks.description: Ordered top-K chunks with bm25_score, rrf_score, and mmr_score.

returned_count.description: Number of deduplicated top-K chunks returned.

total_candidates.description: Number of input candidate chunks scored.
